title: Hurt
text: {who} is down by the ruins and can't walk. Their neighbours are at the windows. Predators may still be about.

choices.label: Everyone stays indoors
choices.reply: The doors stay shut. Help comes the way it comes. Some of the neighbours don't forgive it.

choices.label: Let them carry {who} in
choices.reply: Four of them run out with a door for a stretcher.

choices.label: Talk them through it
choices.reply: We stay on {who}'s channel: pressure here, breathe, don't move. They hold on.
